steps.detail: {"code":"sim.locked","sev":"error","title":"Mechanism locked: constraints cannot be satisfied","t":0.23200000000000018,"detail":"The joint constraints could not be satisfied after this step (position solve did not converge). Stopped at t = 0.232 s with Crank pivot (motor) at 20.42° from its design position. The joints that could not be closed: Coupler–rocker pin (7.6e-2 mm), Crank pin (5.2e-2 mm), Rocker pivot (4.0e-2 mm). This is a four-bar loop with ground 100, crank 55, coupler 60, rocker 70 mm: shortest + longest = 155 mm exceeds the sum of the other two = 130 mm (Grashof condition violated), so no link can rotate fully. The crank reached a dead-centre where coupler and rocker are stretched in line. Shorten the crank or ground link, or lengthen the coupler/rocker."}
